senses.sense_definition: A storage area in early churches located near the chancel for keeping books and vestments.

examples.text: The ancient <w>apothesis</w> was carefully restored to preserve the original layout of the church.
Historians discovered old manuscripts hidden within the <w>apothesis</w> of the primitive basilica.

traits.comment: Refers to a specific architectural feature in historical church design.

senses.sense_definition: A room for changing clothes attached to an ancient public bathhouse.

examples.text: Visitors to the Roman ruins can still see the remains of the <w>apothesis</w> near the main bathing hall.
The <w>apothesis</w> served as a functional space for bathers to leave their belongings before entering the water.

traits.comment: Refers to a specific room in ancient Roman bath complexes.
